tests.name: decimal_missing_point_rejected
tests.description: integer without decimal point should be rejected
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { decimal("5") == decimal("5.0") };

tests.name: decimal_empty_rejected
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { decimal("") == decimal("0.0") };

tests.name: decimal_missing_int_part_rejected
tests.description: .5 without integer part should be rejected
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { decimal(".5") == decimal("0.5") };

tests.name: decimal_missing_frac_part_rejected
tests.description: 1. without fractional digits should be rejected
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { decimal("1.") == decimal("1.0") };

tests.name: decimal_too_many_frac_digits_rejected
tests.description: more than four fractional digits should be rejected
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { decimal("1.23456") == decimal("1.2345") };

tests.name: decimal_non_digit_rejected
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { decimal("abc") == decimal("0.0") };

tests.name: decimal_lone_minus_rejected
tests.description: lone minus sign should be rejected
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { decimal("-") == decimal("0.0") };

tests.name: decimal_overflow_rejected
tests.description: value beyond i64 range when scaled should be rejected
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { decimal("9999999999999999.0") == decimal("0.0") };

tests.name: decimal_max_plus_one_ulp_rejected
tests.description: one ulp above the i64 max (922337203685477.5808) must be rejected
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { decimal("922337203685477.5808") == decimal("0.0") };

tests.name: decimal_min_minus_one_ulp_rejected
tests.description: one ulp below the i64 min (-922337203685477.5809) must be rejected
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { decimal("-922337203685477.5809") == decimal("0.0") };

tests.name: decimal_method_on_long_rejected
tests.description: lessThan on a Long receiver should be rejected as type error

tests.name: decimal_method_with_long_arg_rejected
tests.description: lessThan with a Long argument should be rejected as type error
